## getGeneralAdapterRequirementsPermit() function

Computes the EIP-2612 permit `Requirement` an integrator must sign so that `GeneralAdapter1` can pull `amount` of `token`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getGeneralAdapterRequirementsPermit: (viemClient: Client, params: {
    token: Address;
    chainId: number;
    args: {
        amount: bigint;
    };
    nonce: bigint;
    supportDeployless?: boolean;
}) => Promise<import("../../../index.js").Requirement<import("../../../index.js").PermitRequirementSignature, undefined>[]>
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;import("../../../index.js").[Requirement](./morpho-sdk.requirement.md)<!-- -->&lt;import("../../../index.js").[PermitRequirementSignature](./morpho-sdk.permitrequirementsignature.md)<!-- -->, undefined&gt;\[\]&gt;

A single-element array containing the exact-amount `Requirement` to sign.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.token`<!-- -->: ERC-20 token address (must support EIP-2612).

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: The chain the bundle targets.

- `params.args.amount`<!-- -->: Required token amount.

- `params.nonce`<!-- -->: The user's current EIP-2612 nonce on `token`<!-- -->.

- `params.supportDeployless`<!-- -->: Whether to fetch token metadata via deployless multicall.

## Example


```ts
import { createWalletClient, http } from "viem";
import { mainnet } from "viem/chains";
import { getGeneralAdapterRequirementsPermit } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const client = createWalletClient({ chain: mainnet, transport: http() });
const reqs = await getGeneralAdapterRequirementsPermit(client, {
  token: USDC, // an ERC-2612-compatible token; DAI is excluded by getGeneralAdapterRequirements
  chainId: 1,
  args: { amount: 1_000_000n },
  nonce: 0n,
});
// reqs satisfies Requirement[]
```
